# S62 — Slivers as their own items under the cap

**Findings:**  · **Size:** L · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

A sliver is a small item carved from a slice, linked by parent, so a cheaper model can implement it (glossary.md:154). design.md:185 says slivers run as their own items under the cap. No cap is enforced today: the caps are only fields (registry.go:75,89) and launchRun has no check. Cap enforcement is S05.

From S10 (carried here from S08): split-part and sliver prompts need the same 'no handoff before review' wording as the implementer prompt.

The worktree guard at runs.go:276-281 already blocks a parallel run on one worktree, so slivers queue behind the parent's current run. design.md:185 (their own items) is to be corrected in this slice.
